formulas.name: Arithmetic Mean
formulas.inputs: N valid samples in a defined window
formulas.purpose: Average behaviour in a stable/contextual window
formulas.applicableStates: Any state where a window summary is meaningful
formulas.guardrail: Do not average across different contexts or BAD/MISSING samples

formulas.name: Median / P50
formulas.purpose: Robust central value; less sensitive to spikes than mean
formulas.guardrail: Must use enough representative samples

formulas.name: Minimum / Maximum
formulas.guardrail: Extremes are sensitive to spikes; retain quality/spike flags

formulas.name: Percentiles
formulas.logic: P05, P25, P50, P75, P95, P99 from ordered valid data
formulas.purpose: Distribution-based baseline and robust operating bands
formulas.guardrail: Percentile method must be consistent/versioned across implementation
formulas.example: Pressure P50=78 bar, P95=82 bar (example only)

formulas.name: Sample Standard Deviation
formulas.guardrail: Sensitive to outliers; pair with quality/outlier review
formulas.example: Mean 100, s 2.5 -> normal variability approximately 2.5 units

formulas.name: Variance
formulas.guardrail: Less intuitive for UI; mostly internal

formulas.name: Range
formulas.guardrail: Uses only extremes; spike-sensitive

formulas.name: Coefficient of Variation
formulas.purpose: Compare relative variability at different operating magnitudes
formulas.guardrail: Do not use when mean is zero/near-zero

formulas.name: Median Absolute Deviation
formulas.purpose: Robust measure of spread for noisy/outlier-prone data
formulas.guardrail: Use versioned implementation; not interchangeable with standard deviation

formulas.name: Absolute Deviation
formulas.purpose: Preserve direction and engineering magnitude of deviation
formulas.guardrail: Expected value must match current context

formulas.name: Percentage Deviation
formulas.applicableStates: Where expected value is meaningfully nonzero
formulas.guardrail: If expected is zero/near-zero, return NOT_APPLICABLE and use absolute/robust normalization

formulas.name: Setpoint Error
formulas.guardrail: Setpoint change itself is context, not automatically a fault

formulas.name: Normalized Residual
formulas.inputs: Actual, expected model, scale such as baseline s or robust scale
formulas.purpose: Compare model residuals across operating ranges
formulas.applicableStates: When expected-value model and valid scale exist
formulas.guardrail: Scale definition must be versioned; avoid divide by near-zero

formulas.name: Rate of Change
formulas.inputs: Two or more time-aligned valid samples
formulas.guardrail: Use true timestamps; reject duplicate/invalid time deltas

formulas.name: Simple Moving Average
formulas.guardrail: Window must be signal-specific; do not hide short dangerous excursions from hard-limit handling

formulas.name: Rolling Standard Deviation
formulas.guardrail: Window and minimum N are parameter-specific
formulas.example: Feed s rises from 1.5 to 8 kg/h

formulas.name: Linear Trend Slope
formulas.logic: Fit X = a + b*t; output b
formulas.purpose: Separate flat behaviour from sustained rise/fall
formulas.guardrail: Do not over-interpret nonlinear/transient windows

formulas.name: Exponentially Weighted Moving Average
formulas.purpose: Smooth while weighting recent values more strongly
formulas.guardrail: alpha must be configured/versioned; hard limits bypass smoothing

formulas.name: Z-Score
formulas.inputs: Current X; contextual mean and s
formulas.purpose: Express deviation in baseline standard-deviation units
formulas.guardrail: Z-score is evidence, not a fault; unreliable if s near zero or baseline poor

formulas.name: Modified Z-Score
formulas.inputs: Current X; contextual median and MAD
formulas.purpose: Robust distance when outliers distort mean/s
formulas.guardrail: Return NOT_APPLICABLE if MAD is zero/too small

formulas.name: Persistence
formulas.purpose: Separate transient spikes from sustained abnormality
formulas.guardrail: Minimum valid N and duration must be configured per feature/fault

formulas.name: Pearson Correlation
formulas.purpose: Quantify linear co-movement as supporting evidence
formulas.guardrail: Correlation is not causation; require physical relationship from DOC-01
formulas.example: Torque-current may be strongly positive in stable context

formulas.name: Expected-Value Residual
formulas.guardrail: Expected model must match state/config/recipe

formulas.name: Missing Data Percentage
formulas.guardrail: Expected count comes from acquisition metadata

formulas.name: Stability State
formulas.logic: STABLE when configured variability + abs(ROC) + context-change conditions remain inside healthy limits for the required persistence window
formulas.purpose: State transitions, baseline learning and fault logic
formulas.guardrail: Thresholds are contextual/machine-configured; no universal number
formulas.example: RPM and feed both STABLE before steady baseline learning

formulas.name: Change State
formulas.logic: Compare current context/setpoint to previous validated context using configured change rules
formulas.purpose: Suppress false faults during intentional operating changes
formulas.guardrail: Do not infer unchanged if context input is missing

formulas.name: Specific Energy from Active Power
formulas.purpose: Energy input per unit production; compare like contexts
formulas.guardrail: If throughput <= configured minimum or BAD, return NOT_APPLICABLE/INSUFFICIENT_DATA

formulas.name: Mechanical Shaft Power
formulas.purpose: Estimate mechanical power when true torque is available
formulas.guardrail: Do not apply to torque % without rated torque definition; know whether torque is per shaft or total drive

formulas.name: Specific Mechanical Energy
formulas.guardrail: Drive efficiency and torque basis must be documented; not interchangeable with consumed electrical specific energy

formulas.name: Torque per Throughput
formulas.guardrail: Supporting feature only; preserve torque basis and avoid near-zero throughput

formulas.name: Current Load Percentage
formulas.guardrail: Rated current is MACHINE-SPECIFIC authority metadata; current is not a substitute for torque

formulas.name: Power Load Percentage
formulas.guardrail: Use correct rated active power basis

formulas.name: Differential Melt Pressure
formulas.guardrail: Pressure tap locations and units must be known; do not compute across unrelated locations

formulas.name: Pressure per Feed
formulas.purpose: Simple relationship feature for like contexts
formulas.guardrail: Pressure-feed relation can be nonlinear; supporting feature only
formulas.example: Compare to contextual baseline, not universal limit

formulas.name: Pressure per Throughput
formulas.guardrail: Supporting feature only; guard low throughput

formulas.name: Expected Pressure Residual
formulas.inputs: Actual pressure; expected model from recipe/RPM/feed/temp/config
formulas.purpose: Relationship anomaly that adjusts for normal context
formulas.guardrail: Expected model version and confidence required

formulas.name: Zone Temperature Error
formulas.inputs: Actual and setpoint for each of Z1-Z7
formulas.guardrail: Do not compare zone values without setpoint/context

formulas.name: Zone-to-Zone Temperature Gradient
formulas.guardrail: Interpret against the commanded recipe profile

formulas.name: Thermal Profile Error Vector
formulas.purpose: Detect localized or distributed profile abnormality
formulas.guardrail: Use vector magnitude/pattern only with documented method/version

formulas.name: Melt-vs-Barrel Temperature Difference
formulas.purpose: Separate material thermal state from barrel temperature
formulas.guardrail: Reference zone/profile must be explicit; not universal

formulas.name: Cooling Delta-T
formulas.guardrail: Interpret with flow; temperature difference alone cannot prove heat duty

formulas.name: Feed Command Error
formulas.guardrail: Account for refill/transient status

formulas.name: Feed Stability State
formulas.logic: Combine feed rolling s/CV, ROC, range and persistence against contextual healthy limits
formulas.guardrail: Thresholds from healthy context, not universal
formulas.example: Stable mean can still hide surging

formulas.name: Pressure Stability State
formulas.logic: Combine pressure variability, ROC, range, trend and residual
formulas.guardrail: Classify only with GOOD synchronized data

formulas.name: Torque Stability State
formulas.logic: Combine torque variability, ROC, residual and persistence
formulas.guardrail: VFD torque estimate quality must be known

formulas.name: Expected Torque Model
formulas.logic: Torque_expected = f(recipe, feed, RPM, melt_temp, screw_config, optional side_feed)
formulas.purpose: Model normal process load instead of using one fixed threshold
formulas.guardrail: Start with bins/lookup surfaces; regression/ML only after validated data. Store model confidence/version.
formulas.example: Actual torque - expected torque becomes residual

formulas.name: Expected Pressure Model
formulas.logic: Pressure_expected = f(recipe, feed, RPM, melt_temp, screw_config, die/screen_config)
formulas.guardrail: Model must change/version with downstream configuration

formulas.name: Expected Specific Energy Model
formulas.logic: SE_expected = f(recipe, feed, RPM, screw_config, product)
formulas.guardrail: Compare like contexts; power meter/VFD basis must remain consistent

formulas.name: Current-Torque Consistency Residual
formulas.inputs: Motor current; torque; RPM; drive config
formulas.purpose: Detect drive/measurement inconsistency vs process load
formulas.guardrail: Expected relationship is machine/drive-specific; not a universal equation
formulas.example: Torque high with normal current may indicate contradictory evidence
